newsitem.title: GERMANY: 23 injured in accident at Germany's Oktoberfest.
newsitem.headline: 23 injured in accident at Germany's Oktoberfest.

text.p: Twenty-three people were injured during a rollercoaster ride at Munich's Oktoberfest festival on Monday, a fire brigade spokesman said.
He said eight people had been taken to hospital, several of them thought to be suffering from broken bones.
A police spokesman said one carriage crashed into another which had come to a standstill in the middle of its ride. It was believed that a technical fault was to blame.
The Oktoberfest, the annual celebration of beer and bratwurst which attracts around seven million visitors, runs until October 6.
